card.name: End of the second drug in interactions
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug name (or 'inhibitors' after ACE) when it is the affected drug in an interaction sentence, such as 'effect of X on nifedipine' or 'with propranolol'. It fires just before the text says the effect may change.

modes.label: Drug name ending
modes.description: Final piece of a drug name that is the object of an interaction statement.
modes.example: Use of rifampin in combination with zolpid<<em>> may decrease the efficacy of zolpid

modes.description: The word inhibitors closing the class name ACE inhibitors in a drug-interaction warning.
